full_prompt_en: A whimsical ink-and-flat-color illustration presents a compact imaginary town as one freestanding, rounded mass against a continuous warm golden background. Tiny stacked rooms, doorways, balconies, roofs, and narrow platforms form an intricate cutaway neighborhood, with a few quiet residents visible in openings. Several buildings are simplified into tall rounded heads with small dot eyes and restrained line mouths, so human expression merges naturally with the town's geometry. A pair of thin branching trees rise above and beside the structure, their muted olive crowns and bare twigs giving the crowded architecture a lighter vertical rhythm. The main cluster sits centered with a generous margin of empty yellow around it; its lower edge rests on a few fine horizontal ground lines and a short dark support. Narrow black outlines define every room and rail, but they vary slightly in weight and wobble like a careful pen drawing. Small crosshatched marks, brick-like strokes, and mottled print grain lend the tiny spaces a tactile, handmade feel. The color is held in broad, nearly matte patches of pale mustard, cream, charcoal black, dusty blue, sage green, and sparing burnt orange. Dark voids and black windows punctuate the pale faces, while warm orange fragments sit low among the cooler blue compartments. Light is even and shadowless, with no modeled volume; depth comes from overlap, different scales of detail, and the stacked silhouette. Despite the abundant miniature incident, the large golden field keeps the image calm, curious, and legible as a single playful emblem.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅异想天开的墨线与平涂色插画，把紧凑的想象小城呈为一团独立、圆润的形体，置于连续的暖金色背景前。微小的层叠房间、门洞、阳台、屋顶和狭窄平台组成精密的剖面街区，几位安静居民从开口中可见。有些建筑被简化成长而圆的头像，只有点状眼睛和克制的线条嘴巴，使人的表情自然融入城镇几何。几棵细枝树从结构上方与两侧升起，暗橄榄色树冠和裸枝给拥挤的建筑带来较轻的竖向节奏。主簇群居中，周围留有宽阔空白黄色边缘；其下缘落在几道纤细水平地面线上和短小深色支柱上。窄黑线界定每间房和栏杆，粗细略有变化，像细心钢笔画一样微微颤动。细小交叉排线、砖状短笔和斑驳印刷颗粒赋予微型空间可触的手作感。颜色收在近乎哑光的大块浅芥黄、奶油、炭黑、灰蓝、鼠尾草绿和少量焦橙中。黑色空洞和窗在浅色面孔间形成标点，暖橙碎片低伏于更冷的蓝色隔间中。光照均匀无影，不塑造体积；深度来自叠压、细节的不同尺度和堆叠剪影。尽管微小事件丰富，大片金色场域仍令画面平静、好奇，并作为一个俏皮的整体标志清晰可读。
style_prompt_en: Fine black ink linework and nearly matte flat color form a compact, playful illustration with a handmade print character. The contour is narrow, slightly variable, and gently irregular; tiny crosshatching, stipples, and short brick-like marks add texture inside otherwise simple shapes. A warm mustard field occupies most of the picture, while a dense central cluster combines cream, charcoal, dusty blue, muted olive, and small burnt-orange accents. Rounded upright forms meet rectilinear compartments and thin branching lines, producing a lively scale change between large quiet faces and miniature interior detail. Black openings work as rhythmic punctuation across lighter areas. The image has even, shadowless illumination and little modeled volume, so spatial depth is carried by stacking, overlap, and the silhouette's changing edge. The broad empty surround gives the many small parts room to read as one balanced emblem. Slight grain and imperfect line registration preserve the warmth of drawing on paper.
style_prompt_zh: 细黑墨线和近乎哑光的平涂色组成紧凑俏皮、带手工印刷气质的插画。轮廓窄、粗细微变且轻微不规则；细小交叉排线、点痕和砖状短笔为原本简洁的形状内部增添纹理。暖芥黄色场域占画面大部，密集中央簇群汇合奶油、炭黑、灰蓝、暗橄榄和少量焦橙点缀。圆润的直立形与矩形隔间及细分枝线相遇，在大而安静的面块与微型内部细节之间形成活泼的尺度变化。黑色开口像节奏性的标点散布在浅色区域。画面照明均匀无影，几乎不塑造体积，空间深度由堆叠、叠压和轮廓边缘的变化承载。宽阔留白让众多小部分仍能作为一个平衡的整体标志被读出。轻微颗粒和不完美的线条套准保留纸上绘画的温度。
theme_en: A compact imaginary town of small rooms and quiet residents stands on a golden field
theme_zh: 一座由小房间和安静居民组成的想象小城立在金色原野上
name: Ivan Brunetti
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
